source_genealogy_findings: INSEC is admitted as a second Nepal originating family only for explicit incident-level civilian records in its Yearbook. The pre-existing cumulative victim_total_cumulative field remains semantically insufficient and is not reclassified as civilian direct harm.

Afghanistan Rights Monitor is admitted as an independent Afghanistan overlap family because its 2010 report describes its own gathering and verification effort using indigenous knowledge and local conflict-affected-community information and reports a distinct casualty total.
Human Rights Watch is retained but excluded from the independence gate because its 2006-2008 aggregate casualty construction explicitly drew on UNAMA among several sources for some periods.
AIHRC's contemporaneously reported 2010 figures are retained as a candidate but do not count toward the gate until the primary collection methodology is verified.

source_byte_binding.INSEC: A separate locally archived INSEC complete-report PDF already has a hash, but it is not the same Yearbook 2007 byte stream used for these incident records; no false hash substitution is permitted.
source_byte_binding.ARM: The primary report is source/title/locator bound in this pass; immutable source-byte acquisition remains pending.
source_byte_binding.rule: URL identity is not a content hash. Blank hashes remain blank until exact bytes are archived and hashed.
